note.zh-TW: 教材英文寫 interest guarantee，不是通用說法，列為別名；課程的門檻只當「課程參考值」顯示，不計分。
note.en: The course’s English term interest guarantee is not standard usage and is kept as an alias; the course threshold is shown only as a course reference value and is not scored.

definition.zh-TW:
公司繳稅和付利息之前賺到的利潤，夠付幾倍的利息。

倍數越高，就算獲利下滑也還付得起利息；倍數接近一倍時，利息幾乎吃掉全部利潤。
definition.en:
How many times the profit earned before tax and interest covers the interest charge.

The higher the multiple, the more profit can fall before interest becomes unaffordable; near one, interest consumes almost all of the profit.

example.zh-TW: 兩個數字都在損益表上。沒有利息費用時分母為 0，顯示 N/A。
example.en: Both figures are on the income statement. With no interest expense the denominator is zero and the result is N/A.

misconception.zh-TW: 用本期淨利當分子。淨利已經扣掉利息和所得稅，用它會低估公司付利息的能力；要把利息和稅加回去，看的是繳稅付息之前有多少錢可以付利息。
misconception.en: Using profit for the period as the numerator. Profit is already after interest and tax and would understate the ability to pay interest; add both back to see how much is available before interest and tax.

formula.zh-TW: 利息保障倍數 ＝（稅前淨利 ＋ 利息費用）÷ 利息費用。分子就是息前稅前盈餘。
formula.en: Times interest earned = (profit before tax + interest expense) ÷ interest expense. The numerator is earnings before interest and tax.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
